arxiv-2006-08435.title: Efficient Ab-Initio Molecular Dynamic Simulations by Offloading Fast Fourier Transformations to FPGAs
arxiv-2006-08435.creator: Arjun Ramaswami 1 , Tobias Kenter 2 , Thomas D. Kühne 3 and Christian Plessl 4
arxiv-2006-08435.description: Abstract A large share of today’s HPC workloads is used for AIMD ( AIMD ) simulations, where the interatomic forces are computed on-the-fly by means of accurate electronic structure calculations. They are computationally intensive and thus constitute an interesting application class for energy-efficient hardware accelerators such as FPGA .

arxiv-2101-10663.title: Extreme case of density scaling: The Weeks-Chandler-Andersen system at low temperatures
arxiv-2101-10663.creator: Eman Attia, Jeppe C. Dyre, Ulf R. Pedersen
arxiv-2101-10663.description: Abstract This paper studies numerically the Weeks-Chandler-Andersen (WCA) system, which is shown to obey hidden scale invariance with a density-scaling exponent that varies from below 5 to above 500. This unprecedented variation makes it advantageous to use the fourth-order Runge-Kutta algorithm for tracing out isomorphs.

arxiv-2107-09285.title: Neural Abstructions : Abstractions that Support Construction for Grounded Language Learning
arxiv-2107-09285.creator: Kaylee Burns, Christopher D. Manning, Li Fei-Fei
arxiv-2107-09285.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kaylee Burns, Christopher D. Manning, Li Fei-Fei. Although virtual agents are increasingly situated in environments where natural language is the most effective mode of interaction with humans, these exchanges are rarely used as an opportunity for learning. Leveraging language interactions effectively requires addressing limitations in the two most common approaches to language grounding: semantic parsers built on top of fixed object categories are precise but inflexible and end-to-end models are maximally expressive, but fickle and opaque.

arxiv-2309-07966.title: Emergent nucleosynthesis from a 1.2 second long simulation of a black-hole accretion disk Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2309-07966.creator: Trevor M. Sprouse, Kelsey A. Lund, Jonah M. Miller, Gail C. McLaughlin, Matthew R. Mumpower
arxiv-2309-07966.description: Abstract We simulate a black-hole accretion disk system with full-transport general relativistic neutrino radiation magnetohydrodynamics (GR ν \nu RMHD) for 1.2 seconds. This system is likely to form after the merger of two compact objects and is thought to be a robust site of r r -process nucleosynthesis.

arxiv-2310-16395.title: A note on no-hair properties of static black holes in four and higher dimensional spacetimes with cosmological constant
arxiv-2310-16395.creator: Akihiro Ishibashi, Satoshi Matsumoto, Yuichiro Yoneo
arxiv-2310-16395.description: Abstract We study no-hair properties of static black holes in four and higher dimensional spacetimes with a cosmological constant. For the vanishing cosmological constant case, we show a no-hair theorem and also a no-short-hair theorem under certain conditions for the energy-momentum of matter fields.

arxiv-2406-13444.title: VDebugger: Harnessing Execution Feedback for Debugging Visual Programs
arxiv-2406-13444.creator: Xueqing Wu, Zongyu Lin, Songyan Zhao, Te-Lin Wu, Pan Lu
arxiv-2406-13444.description: Abstract Visual programs are executable code generated by large language models to address visual reasoning problems. They decompose complex questions into multiple reasoning steps and invoke specialized models for each step to solve the problems. However, these programs are prone to logic errors, with our preliminary evaluation showing that 58% of the total errors are caused by program logic errors.

arxiv-2501-06123.title: Numerical Methods for Chaotic ODE
arxiv-2501-06123.creator: Robert M. Corless
arxiv-2501-06123.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Robert M. Corless. This paper explores backward error analysis for numerical solutions of ordinary differential equations, particularly focusing on chaotic systems. Three approaches are examined: residual assessment, the method of modified equations, and shadowing. We investigate how these methods explain the success of numerical simulations in capturing the behavior of chaotic systems, even when facing issues like spurious chaos introduced by numerical methods or suppression of chaos by numerical methods.

arxiv-2505-11387.title: High brightness, symmetric electron bunch generation in a plasma wakefield accelerator via a radially-polarized plasma photocathode
arxiv-2505-11387.creator: J. Chappell, E. Archer, R. Walczak, S. M. Hooker
arxiv-2505-11387.description: Abstract The plasma photocathode has previously been proposed as a source of ultra-high-brightness electron bunches within plasma accelerators. Here, the scheme is extended by using a radially-polarized ionizing laser pulse to generate high-charge, high-brightness electron bunches with symmetric transverse emittance.

arxiv-2509-18667.title: TERAG: Token-Efficient Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv-2509-18667.creator: Qiao Xiao 1, Hong Ting Tsang 2, Jiaxin Bai 2
arxiv-2509-18667.description: Abstract Graph-based Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a widely studied approach for improving the reasoning, accuracy, and factuality of Large Language Models. However, many existing graph-based RAG systems overlook the high cost associated with LLM token usage during graph construction, hindering large-scale adoption.

pmc-11289859.title: Association between polymorphisms of DNA repair genes and intracranial aneurysms: A systematic review and meta‑analysis
pmc-11289859.creator: Mohamed M. Montasr, George Fotakopoulos, Vasiliki Epameinondas Georgakopoulou, Ourania Fotakopoulou, Nikolaos Trakas, Pagona Sklapani, Kostas N. Fountas

pmc-12565020.title: Idarucizumab Reversal in Subdural Hemorrhage: A Single-Center Experience
pmc-12565020.creator: Anita Mrvar Brečko, Monika Simerl Jožef, Ana Trebše, Matija Zupan, Tomaž Velnar, Senta Frol, Mengliang Zhang
pmc-12565020.description: Prompt reversal of anticoagulation in the elderly population with subdural hematoma (SDH) is critical to reduce morbidity and facilitate timely surgical intervention. In patients receiving dabigatran, idarucizumab provides rapid anticoagulation reversal. We evaluated clinical and radiological outcomes of dabigatran-treated SDH patients receiving idarucizumab, including those undergoing surgical management.

pmc-13284951.title: Blunt Trauma-Induced Inferior Vena Cava Thrombosis and Renal Artery Injury With Abdominal Compartment Syndrome and Multi-organ Failure
pmc-13284951.creator: Rohit Chauhan, Madhur Uniyal, Vasishta Nadella
pmc-13284951.description: Inferior vena cava (IVC) thrombosis is a rare but serious complication. We report a case of delayed presentation of abdominal compartment syndrome (ACS) secondary to IVC thrombosis, which contributed to progressive multi-organ dysfunction syndrome. Increased intra-abdominal pressure further resulted in venous stasis and thrombus formation, exacerbating systemic deterioration.
